== Hero Usage ==
*Heroes use Convert Hexes as soon as an ally has been hexed. They will not reserve Convert Hexes for use with Necromancer hexes, nor will they wait for an ally be under the effects of multiple hexes to better take advantage of the skill's ability to remove all hexes.

== Notes ==
{{bug|Convert Hexes only grants +10 armor, whether it removes one or more Necromancer hexes.}}	
* If this skill functioned as intended it could be used to achieve the highest armor rating possible for any [[profession]]. If all Necromancer hexes were used against you, you would gain an additional 430 armor rating.

== Trivia ==
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
